ModMetaData.name: Quest log cleanup
ModMetaData.author: Blue-Pentagram
ModMetaData.description: Add's a way to dismiss your whole completed quest list with options to do it if it was a (Successfull, Failed or Expired) outcome and with it being hidden how removeing a quest in the vanilla method way the games does or fully removeing the quest from the game. (Warning can cause issues with quest progress if it's a subquest)
